connector.name: 1password
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for 1Password service accounts - tools and resources for vaults and credentials
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package 1password-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cakerepository account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
env.description: The Service Account Token from 1Password (required unless OP_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE is used on macOS)

env.name: OP_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE
env.description: macOS only: Keychain service name to read the 1Password service account token from when OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN is not set

env.name: OP_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT
env.description: macOS only: Optional Keychain account name to narrow the lookup used with OP_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE
